newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid $68, passed - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid $68, passed - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle bids at $68.00 per cwt were passed by owners early Tuesday who were asking $69.00 to $70.00, feedlot sources said.
"The tone feels real stout," a Kansas cattle feeder said.
Showlists this week were down sharply following last week's hefty sales, which drained pens of well-finished cattle, sources said.
Showlists in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area were pegged near 85,500 head, down 6,500 from last week. Kansas was estimated near 82,000 head, down 7,000, sources there said.
